dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: You may easily have time, but you will not easily obtain perfume made by Ms. Emilie.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Fragrance is no mere scent. It is a lifestyle. It is what we leave behind in living's wake.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Do you think such aromas dissipate all too easily? I will not deny that.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: But why, then, do they find new life within our dreams?

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: She moves much like perfume herself. You cannot reach her, nor can she be stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: She is not employed by the Confrerie of Cabriere, nor does she work with any fixed brand.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: But still, she remains the most famous perfume designer in Fontaine. The elegant, fashionable ladies of Fontaine would even give a precious gem for her perfume.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Hmm... In that case, simply take it as if I added a "so I've heard" to that statement.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've no use for perfume for now...

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: The tide is ever-changing, but fragrance ever lingers.
